result.summary: The home screen looks mostly complete; the only notable visual problem is the category chip row sitting under the search field, which is clipped on both the left and right edges.

issues.description: The first category chip (All) is flush against the left edge of the screen with no matching inset, so the rounded pill appears cut off on the left while the last chip is also clipped on the right.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding (or inset) to the chip row so the first and last chips sit fully inside the screen margins.
